newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JCI appoints Kebble as executive director.
newsitem.headline: JCI appoints Kebble as executive director.

text.p: South African black-controlled mining house JCI Ltd announced on Tuesday it had appointed Brett Kebble as an executive director of the company.
Kebble is currently an executive director of Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd.
JCI's Western Areas Gold Mining Co Ltd also announced that Kebble had been appointed its chairman as well as a director.

"Brett Kebble has a great deal of experience in the mining industry. His fresh vision and well respected financial abilities will make a significant contribution to JCI and I am delighted that he has agreed to join us at a time when so many opportunities are opening up for the company," said JCI chairman Mzi Khumalo.
"I have said before that the quality and mix of skills within the JCI Ltd executive are simply second to none and I am more confident than ever that JCI is poised for major success."
